title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
As AI Automation Specialist with a strong passion for AI-native software engineering and hands-on expertise in Agentic AI, Generative AI, and autonomous development frameworks. The ideal candidate will be capable of translating business requirements into production-ready applications by leveraging AI-powered development workflows, multi-agent systems, and modern software engineering practices. This role requires the ability to rapidly design, build, test, and deploy customer-specific software solutions using a combination of strong programming skills, telecom OSS knowledge, and AI-assisted development tools.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI-native, cloud-native, and web-based applications using Go, Java, Python, microservices, and distributed system architectures.
* Build end-to-end software solutions using Agentic AI frameworks, LLMs, and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery.
* Develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, automation platforms, and enterprise applications using Spring Boot and event-driven architectures.
* Design and orchestrate AI agents, multi-agent systems, autonomous workflows, and intelligent copilots to automate engineering and business processes.
* Integrate Generative AI, LLMs, RAG pipelines, MCP-based integrations, and AI assistants into telecom OSS and enterprise applications.
* Leverage AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT for code generation, testing, debugging, documentation, and deployment.
* Build scalable, secure, and resilient applications using Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and modern cloud-native technologies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver customer-specific solutions, optimize performance and code quality, and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve productivity and innovation.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) with 5–10 years of relevant software engineering experience and the ability to design, develop, and deliver production-ready software solutions.
* Strong proficiency in Go and/or Java, with expertise in microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native development.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, and MCP-based integrations.
* Expertise in AI coding assistants and autonomous development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude to accelerate software development.

**It would be nice if you also had:**

* Ability to build intelligent applications integrating AI-driven reasoning, orchestration, and automation with traditional software engineering.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, cloud-native architectures, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, scalability, engineering best practices, and end-to-end solution development.
* Telecom OSS/BSS experience and knowledge of NETCONF, RESTCONF, YANG, network automation, and AI integration into enterprise applications are strong advantages.

**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
  
  
Learn more about life at Nokia .
  
  
**Our recruitment process**
We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
  
  
The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
  
  
**About The Team**
Some of our benefits in India:
  
  

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements to support work–life balance
* Health and well-being support – medical insurance for you and your family, health check-ups, life and accident insurance, well-being programs, and employee resource groups
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave based on eligibility
* Personal Support Service 24/7 – a confidential support channel open to all Nokia employees and their families in challenging situations
* Career growth & mobility – technical career paths, job rotations, international assignments, and relocation support
* Continuous learning – technical certifications, mentoring programs, coaching, and digital learning platforms
* Opportunities to innovate and contribute through Nokia’s research and development environment
* Recognition programs that celebrate outstanding contributions
* Workplace support – ergonomic working support and mobile device programs based on eligibility

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About InstantDM

InstantDM is an Instagram and Facebook DM automation platform used by creators, brands and e-commerce businesses to turn social engagement into leads and sales. Built on Meta's official Graph APIs and available on the Shopify App Store, InstantDM powers comment-to-DM automation, story reply automation, multi-step DM flows, follow-ups, lead capture and Meta Ads integrations — at high volume, for customers across India and beyond.

We're a small, fast-moving product team in Tiruppur building software used by businesses globally. You'll ship features that real customers use within days, not months.

The Role

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer with around 1 year of hands-on experience who enjoys owning features end to end — from the API and database to the web dashboard and mobile app. You'll work directly with the founders and product team, and you'll have real ownership from your first month.

What You'll Do

* Build and maintain backend services and APIs in
  **Python**
  that power our automation engine, webhooks and integrations
* Develop features for the InstantDM web dashboard using
  **React**
* Build and improve our mobile app (iOS and Android) using
  **React Native**
* Build fast, SEO-friendly marketing pages, landing pages and docs with
  **Astro**
* Design data models and write efficient queries on
  **DynamoDB**
* Deploy and run services on
  **AWS**
  (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, CloudWatch and related services)
* Integrate with third-party platforms — Meta Graph API (Instagram, Facebook), Shopify, Make.com, Google Sheets
* Handle high-volume, event-driven workloads: queues, rate limiting, retries and webhook processing
* Debug production issues, monitor performance and improve reliability
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code and take part in code reviews
* Work closely with the product and support teams to understand customer problems and ship solutions quickly

What We're Looking For

**Must have**

* ~1 year of professional experience (or equivalent strong project/internship work) as a full stack or backend/frontend developer
* Solid
  **Python**
  skills — building REST APIs
* Good working knowledge of
  **React**
  (hooks, state management, component design)
* Experience with or strong interest in
  **React Native**
  for mobile development
* Familiarity with
  **AWS**
  services and deploying applications to the cloud
* Understanding of
  **NoSQL databases**
  , ideally
  **DynamoDB**
  (keys, indexes, access patterns)
* Comfortable with Git, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS
* Ability to understand a problem, break it down and ship a working solution independently
* Good communication skills in English and/or Tamil

**Nice to have**

* Experience with
  **Astro**
  or other static/SSR frameworks (Next.js, Gatsby)
* Experience with Meta Graph API, Instagram/WhatsApp APIs or Shopify apps
* Serverless architecture experience (AWS Lambda, SAM, Serverless Framework, CDK)
* Exposure to queues and event-driven systems (SQS, SNS, EventBridge)
* Publishing apps to the Play Store / App Store
* Interest in SaaS, marketing automation or e-commerce

Why Join Us

* **Real ownership**
  — your work goes live to thousands of users quickly
* **Full-stack exposure**
  — backend, web, mobile, cloud and integrations, all in one role
* **Learn fast**
  — work directly with founders on a growing global SaaS product
* **Small team, big impact**
  — no layers of bureaucracy
* **Work close to home**
  — a product company based in Tiruppur, no need to move to a metro
* Competitive salary based on skills and experience

Work Details

* **Location:**
  Avinashi, Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu
* **Work mode:**
  Full-time, work from office
* **Salary: 20,000+ / Month**
* **Joining:**
  *Immediate / within 30 days*

title: AI and Agent Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior AI and Agent Engineer will develop, integrate, test, deploy, and monitor AI-enabled applications and agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. The role is responsible for the intelligence, orchestration, actions, integrations, and behavioral quality of AI solutions.
  
  
This is an AI application engineering role, not a prompt-writing position. The successful candidate must be able to build production software, integrate enterprise systems, create evaluation frameworks, troubleshoot complex behavior, and operate deployed solutions.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**AI and agent development**

* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, triggers, workflows, and generative orchestration.
* Develop AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure services.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, multistep orchestration, and human approval patterns.
* Develop custom APIs, Azure Functions, connectors, and supporting application services.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Power Platform, and approved enterprise systems.

**Prompt, context, and behavior engineering**

* Develop system instructions, prompts, grounding logic, response structures, fallback behavior, and escalation rules.
* Implement model selection and routing based on accuracy, risk, latency, and consumption requirements.
* Design agent behavior that distinguishes between answering, recommending, requesting clarification, escalating, and taking action.
* Maintain version control for prompts, instructions, tools, actions, and model configurations.

**Testing and evaluation**

* Develop evaluation datasets with practice SMEs.
* Automate tests for groundedness, relevance, completeness, citation quality, task completion, response consistency, and escalation behavior.
* Perform adversarial testing involving prompt injection, data leakage, unsupported instructions, excessive agency, and unauthorized actions.
* Build regression tests to detect changes caused by models, prompts, source content, integrations, or application releases.
* Document known limitations and expected failure behavior.

**Operations and improvement**

* Instrument solutions for usage, latency, failures, cost, task completion, user feedback, and model behavior.
* Review production telemetry and interaction patterns.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective changes.
* Optimize token consumption, retrieval performance, application latency, and integration reliability.
* Develop reusable agent templates, integration components, evaluation harnesses, and error-handling patterns.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python development skills.
* TypeScript or JavaScript development experience.
* REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, OpenAPI, webhooks, and event-driven integration.
* Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
* Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams integration.
* Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and structured generation.
* Agent orchestration, state management, tool invocation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Automated testing, Git, pull requests, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
* Understanding of prompt injection, data exfiltration, overreliance, hallucination, unsafe actions, and AI-specific failure modes.

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 or more years of software, integration, automation, or data application development.
* Demonstrated production experience with generative AI or conversational AI applications.
* Experience building applications across Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Familiarity with Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Basic C# experience within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.

**Success Measures**

* Evaluation performance against approved acceptance thresholds.
* Task-completion and appropriate-escalation rates.
* Production defect and regression rates.
* Retrieval and grounding quality.
* Response latency and cost per transaction.
* Integration reliability.
* Reuse of standard components.
* Completeness of technical documentation and automated testing.
* Speed and effectiveness of incident remediation.

**Role Boundaries**
This role engineers the behavior of AI applications. Practice SMEs remain accountable for defining and validating authoritative professional content, business rules, acceptable conclusions, and circumstances requiring human review.
